routes: /machines and /map, served by a Pulse binary built from this working tree, fed by a pulse-agent built from the same tree running its host module on a real Ubuntu 24.04 machine.
states: One real Linux host reporting through the branch agent. GET /api/resources from the page: its agent facet carries defaultGateways [{address 192.168.0.1, interface eth0}] and dnsServers [192.168.0.1, 1.1.1.1] (the forwarders behind the host's systemd-resolved stub), which match the host's own `ip route show default` and resolver files read over SSH.
The change adds two optional type fields and no rendering, so the pages draw as before: the machines table lists the host and its drawer opens, and the map draws it.
interactions: Opened the host's row on /machines at both widths.
Opened /map at both widths: no horizontal overflow at 390.
Read the browser console on both pages at both widths: no script errors. It held two connection-reset lines from the moment the rig's server was restarted on the new build while the tab was open.
limits: Nothing draws the new fields yet, so there is no visual difference to compare.
Light theme was not checked: no styling changes.
Linux only. No macOS, Windows or FreeBSD agent was run; on those the agent reports no gateway by design.
